hooks.command: sh -c 'h="${DORE_HOME:-$HOME/.dore-memory}"; for d in "$h" "$HOME/Documents/dore"; do for f in "$d/.venv/bin/dore-hook" "$d/.venv/Scripts/dore-hook.exe"; do [ -f "$f" ] && exec "$f" prompt; done; done' 2>/dev/null || true
